title: Define K-line data and indicator Pydantic schemas
description: Create Pydantic v2 response schemas for K-line data API: KlineBar (OHLCV + date), KlineIndicatorBar (MACD/KDJ/BOLL fields), KlineDataResponse (list of bars with indicators), ChipDistributionResponse, and chip distribution models. Follow existing schema patterns from strategy_backtest.py.
implementation: Create api/v1/schemas/kline.py with Pydantic v2 BaseModel classes
Define KlineBar schema: date(str), open/high/low/close(float), volume(float), amount(Optional[float]), pct_chg(Optional[float])
Define KlineIndicatorBar schema: macd_dif/dea/hist, kdj_k/d/j, boll_upper/middle/lower (all Optional[float])
Define KlineDataResponse schema: code(str), name(str), period(Literal['daily','weekly','monthly']), bars(List[KlineBar]), indicators(List[KlineIndicatorBar])
Define ChipDistributionResponse schema: code, profit_ratio, avg_cost, cost_90_low/high, concentration_90, cost_70_low/high, concentration_70
Add Field() descriptions and Optional defaults for indicator fields (indicators may be None for insufficient data points)

reference.pattern: Pydantic v2 BaseModel with Field descriptions
reference.examples: Follow StrategyBacktestRunResponse pattern - extend from base model, add Field() with description

criteria: 5 schema classes defined: KlineBar, KlineIndicatorBar, KlineDataResponse, ChipDistributionResponse, KlineDataRequest
All numeric fields use float type with Optional where applicable
